//: Phase 0.5.3 demo — a plugin can inject MCP servers into aish's runtime MCP set at load time. Same schema as the user/project .mcp.json. Refs: ${env:VAR} resolves from the process env; ${profile:<login>[:FIELD]} resolves from ~/.aish/credentials ([profile:<login>] section, populated by `login <plugin>`); a bare ${NAME} is left verbatim for the mcp credentials-block interpolation at connect time. Collision policy: first-plugin-by-id wins; project/user .mcp.json servers always shadow plugin servers.
